steps.text: Tale of Wuxia's maps crawled at about 4 fps under Rosetta, which translates the game's x87 maths slowly, while its menus ran fast (winedbg samples in highball-db#352). This asks for a Wine 11 engine, which ships athei's x87sidecar, turns the sidecar on for this game with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 and sets DXVK. Measured by the reporter on Wine 11 r30 with DXVK on an M4: 77.5 fps at the village entrance and 58 in the busy village square (highball-db#352, 2026-11-07).
